`assign` and `remove` change it, so they take only a `Json`.

JsonPointer.get("/languages", doc); // ReadonlyJson | undefined
JsonPointer.assign("/name", doc, "Grace"); // type error

`assign` and `remove` change it, so they take only a `Json`.

JsonPointer.get("/languages", doc); // ReadonlyJson | undefined
JsonPointer.assign("/name", doc, "Grace"); // type error

`assign` and `remove` change it, so they take only a `Json`.

```typescript

JsonPointer.get("/languages", doc); // ReadonlyJson | undefined
JsonPointer.assign("/name", doc, "Grace"); // type error
```
